I'm currently getting my braces done here, and it's been a wonderful experience so far. Each visit has been, quite honestly, very easy and effortless. The procedures and explanations have been great and very professional, and the team has been so reassuring that I actually felt the urge to write this review out of appreciation 🤩.

Everything has been done so gently and professionally, and even moments I expected to be uncomfortable were surprisingly manageable and skillfully handled. It’s clear that the care and experience built over the years are reflected in every part of the visit, from the dentists themselves to the entire staff.

It’s rare to find a dental clinic that combines skill, warmth, and consistency this well. I’m genuinely grateful to be doing my treatment here and couldn’t recommend them enough.

​The Worst Dental Experience I've Ever Had
​I've had 2-3 dental appointments here, but this latest one was absolutely terrible.
​The dentist offered no explanation or pre-procedure consultation whatsoever. I was just taken to the chair, and the assistant only asked to confirm what I was there for.
​The procedure this time was significantly more painful and rough than any previous visit. At one point, I was choking on water in my throat. Instead of having me rinse or using suction, I was simply told to "breathe through my nose."
This is unacceptable.
​I understand I have an abscess and some teeth that need attention (which I plan to have extracted soon, so the diagnosis wasn't a shock). However, the force and roughness used during this procedure were completely unwarranted. I am certain I have never had such a brutal experience before.
​After the procedure, the dentist offered no empathy, no apology, or any feedback. All I was told was to "calm down."
​I don't know what was frustrating the dentist, but my mouth and teeth are not a place to vent that frustration.

I believe I have the patient's right to receive proper treatment and advice (which, of course, I am paying for). However, what happened today was beyond unacceptable.
